Operations.Name: GetLogsMerged
Operations.Description: Stream merged, color-tagged logs from multiple containers over Server-Sent Events

Options.Name: containers
Options.Description: Comma-separated container IDs to merge logs from

Options.Name: tail
Options.Description: Number of lines to tail per container (default 100)

Options.Name: since
Options.Description: Only return logs since this timestamp (Docker since format)

Options.Name: until
Options.Description: Only return logs until this timestamp (Docker until format)

Options.Name: env
Options.Description: Environment the containers belong to (from GET /api/environments)
